findings.title: checkOpenSpec fails a configured project whose openspec CLI is missing
findings.description: A project with openspec/config.yaml but no CLI on PATH is reported as fail, although ship reads change artifacts from disk and never shells out to openspec.
findings.suggestion: Report a configured project with no CLI as warn, naming the two skills that need it.

findings.title: probeVersion discards stderr, so a failed probe's error never reaches the evidence
findings.description: probeVersion runs the binary with stderr ignored, so when `openspec --version` fails the doctor can only say the probe returned nothing; the error that would name the cause (an unsupported Node, a broken install) is lost.
findings.suggestion: Capture stderr and carry its first line into the check's evidence.

findings.title: doctor reports openspec ok when its version probe returns nothing
findings.description: checkOpenSpec records 'version probe returned nothing' as evidence and still returns ok for a configured project (581-588). An openspec on PATH that does not run, most often under a Node older than OpenSpec's floor, passes the doctor while /interlock:spec and /interlock:bootstrap stop at the same `openspec --version` probe.
findings.suggestion: When the CLI resolves but its version probe returns nothing, return warn, say the two skills stop at that probe, and give the Node floor in the fix.
